newsitem.title: USA: HL&P sees South Texas nuke restart Friday.
newsitem.headline: HL&P sees South Texas nuke restart Friday.

text.p: Houston Lighting and Power Co's 1,250 megawatt South Texas nuclear power unit 2 should enter a startup mode and perhaps resynchronize to the electricity grid on Friday, a company spokesman said.
The unit was shut Wednesday after its turbine tripped off line.
"We plan to start it tomorrow," the spokesman said Thursday, adding "if the start up is early in the day, then we will get it synchronized to the grid tomorrow."
The unit is located in Paloacios, Texas.
Houston Lighting is a subsidiary of Houston Industries Inc.
